name: Restaurante Terra Luna
address: Av. Costera Miguel Alemán 2-A, Club Deportivo

tagline.es: Cocina de autor del desayuno a la cena
tagline.en: Chef-driven cooking from breakfast to dinner

specialty: Volcanic-stone octopus, Sterling Silver picaña and Wagyu burgers alongside Guerrero breakfasts

photo_notes.cover: Elegant open dining room on the Costera with white tablecloths, warm pendant lights, plants and a glimpse of the bay at dusk.
photo_notes.s1: Charcoal-grilled octopus on a hot black volcanic stone with olive-seasoned baby potatoes.
photo_notes.s2: Stacked seafood tower of tuna, scallop and shrimp cubes with avocado and cucumber in dark Sinaloa sauce.
photo_notes.s3: Thick Wagyu-Angus burger with goat cheese foam, fig jam and caramelized onion on a brioche bun.
photo_notes.s4: Purple açaí bowl topped with berries, banana slices, coconut and crunchy granola.
